tests.title: Single-use generated promo code discounts an eShop order once and is marked Used with the order
tests.goal: A generated single-use code gives the right discount on a real Bank Transfer order, the CRM order totals match the checkout, and the code cannot be used twice.
preconditions: Staging CRM login; a QA promotion "Promo Code: Get Y% off with discount code X", Applied Shop Online Shop, Multiple Promotion Code (created during the test, e.g. 662), Y = 10, quota 2, codes generated
A QA member is logged in on the eShop with an empty cart; a non-quota product found at runtime (e.g. C)
data: Bank Transfer (fn-bank-transfer) only; shipping 門市自取 with a pickup store

steps.text: On the eShop add the product, open /checkout and note the totals without a code
Apply code 1 -> Expect: "Applied: <code>", Basket Discount line named after the promotion = 10% of the sub-total; member-level promotions (e.g. Silver 15%) are applied on the remaining amount
Place the order with Bank Transfer
In the CRM open the order and the promotion's Multiple Promotion Code tab
Back on the eShop add a product again and apply code 1

expected.text: Thank-you page with the order number
CRM order: Pending Payment, Basket Discount lists the code promotion and the member promotion with the same amounts as the checkout; Total and Bank Transfer payment equal the checkout total
Code 1: Status Used, Txn No. = the order, Txn Member ID = the member; Stock count drops by one
Re-applying code 1 -> "Promotion code is invalid, expired or exceed the usage limit" and no discount
Cleanup: void the order (SCRM-110) and empty the cart

checks.label: Thank-you page with the order number
CRM order: Pending Payment, Basket Discount lists the code promotion and the member promotion with the same amounts as the checkout; Total and Bank Transfer payment equal the checkout total
Code 1: Status Used, Txn No. = the order, Txn Member ID = the member; Stock count drops by one
Re-applying code 1 -> "Promotion code is invalid, expired or exceed the usage limit" and no discount
Cleanup: void the order (SCRM-110) and empty the cart

notes: QA1pr6iu on TXN0126102700025: code -60.00 + Silver -81.00 = Total 459.00 in checkout and CRM; code Used with txn and member; re-apply refused. Voided afterwards.

tests.title: Generating promotion codes is limited by the promotion code quota
tests.goal: Staff cannot create more single-use codes than the quota set on the promotion.
preconditions: Staging CRM login; a QA promotion "Promo Code: Get Y% off with discount code X", Applied Shop Online Shop, Multiple Promotion Code (created during the test, e.g. 662), quota Q (e.g. 2), no codes yet

steps.text: Open the promotion with the pencil icon (edit, not the view icon) > Multiple Promotion Code > Generate
Prefix QA, No. of Promotion Code = Q + 1, Generate
Generate again with No. = Q
Raise the quota by 1 in Promotion Setting, Save, and reopen

expected.text: Step 2: "Not enough code quota to generate code"; no code is created (Total 0 | Stock Q)
Step 3: "Success"; Q codes with the prefix, status Generated; Total Q | Stock 0
Step 4: "Edited rule successfully." and Current Stock: 1

checks.label: Step 2: "Not enough code quota to generate code"; no code is created (Total 0 | Stock Q)
Step 3: "Success"; Q codes with the prefix, status Generated; Total Q | Stock 0
Step 4: "Edited rule successfully." and Current Stock: 1

notes: 3 against quota 2 -> "Not enough code quota to generate code"; 2 -> Success; quota 3 -> Current Stock: 1.

tests.title: A revoked promotion code is refused on the eShop, also when it was applied before it was revoked
tests.goal: Revoking a leaked code stops it immediately, including in carts where it is already applied.
preconditions: Staging CRM login; a QA promotion "Promo Code: Get Y% off with discount code X", Applied Shop Online Shop, Multiple Promotion Code (created during the test, e.g. 662), one Generated code
QA member logged in on the eShop with a product in the cart

steps.text: Apply the code at /checkout -> Expect: Applied
In the CRM click Revoke on that code
On the eShop fill pickup info and Proceed to checkout
Reload /checkout and apply the same code again

expected.text: Step 2: status Revoked, Revoke/Assign buttons gone
Step 3: no order is created (order list unchanged); a warning says the code is invalid
Step 4: "Promotion code is invalid, expired or exceed the usage limit" and no discount

checks.label: Step 2: status Revoked, Revoke/Assign buttons gone
Step 3: no order is created (order list unchanged); a warning says the code is invalid
Step 4: "Promotion code is invalid, expired or exceed the usage limit" and no discount

notes: QAka7BxS and QBgH2nw9 revoked while applied: Proceed refused with "Invalid promotion code.", no order created (latest order still TXN0126102700025); fresh apply refused. Stale checkout display: storeberry-compare BUG-018.

tests.title: Codes that require member assignment work only after they are assigned to the member
tests.goal: "Require Member assignment before use" stops unassigned codes, and Assign validates the member.
preconditions: Staging CRM login; a QA promotion "Promo Code: Get Y% off with discount code X", Applied Shop Online Shop, Multiple Promotion Code (created during the test, e.g. 662), "Require Member assignment before use" ticked, two Generated codes
QA member logged in on the eShop with a product in the cart

steps.text: On the eShop apply unassigned code 1
In the CRM click Assign on code 1 and enter a Member ID that does not exist
Assign code 1 to the QA member
On the eShop apply code 1 again

expected.text: Step 1: refused, no discount
Step 2: "Target Member Not found"; the code stays unassigned
Step 3: "Assigned"; Member ID and Member Reserved At filled, status still Generated
Step 4: "Applied: <code>" with the promotion discount

checks.label: Step 1: refused, no discount
Step 2: "Target Member Not found"; the code stays unassigned
Step 3: "Assigned"; Member ID and Member Reserved At filled, status still Generated
Step 4: "Applied: <code>" with the promotion discount

notes: QC39DgTk refused unassigned; MEMy999999999 -> "Target Member Not found"; assigned to MEMy001164526 -> Applied.

tests.title: Voiding an unpaid eShop order releases its reserved stock
tests.goal: Stock reserved by an online order comes back when staff void it.
preconditions: An unpaid eShop Bank Transfer order placed by a QA member during the test (e.g. from SCRM-106)

steps.text: Before the order: Inventory, search the product SKU, note Available Qty, Stock Qty and the order warehouse column (TaiPo)
After the order: read the same row
Order detail > Actions > Void this order > Yes
Reload the order and read the inventory row again

expected.text: Step 2: Available and the warehouse column drop by the ordered quantity; Stock Qty unchanged
Step 4: Order Status and Payment Status Canceled
Step 4: Available and the warehouse column are back to the step 1 values

checks.label: Step 2: Available and the warehouse column drop by the ordered quantity; Stock Qty unchanged
Step 4: Order Status and Payment Status Canceled
Step 4: Available and the warehouse column are back to the step 1 values

tests.title: Promotion code list shows all times in the same local time zone
tests.goal: Staff can read when a code was created, assigned and used.
preconditions: Staging CRM login; a QA promotion "Promo Code: Get Y% off with discount code X", Applied Shop Online Shop, Multiple Promotion Code (created during the test, e.g. 662), one Generated code

steps.text: Assign the code to a QA member and note the local time
Read Staff Reserved At, Member Reserved At, Created At and Updated At

expected.text: Staff Reserved At and Member Reserved At equal the local time of the assignment
Created At / Updated At are local time in the same readable format (no UTC "Z" marker on local times)

checks.label: Staff Reserved At and Member Reserved At equal the local time of the assignment
Created At / Updated At are local time in the same readable format (no UTC "Z" marker on local times)

notes: Staff Reserved At 2026-10-27 22:12:43 vs Member Reserved At 2026-10-28 06:12:43 (QCDupVR9); Updated At 2026-10-28T06:12:43.000000Z.
